steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Chief! They're catching up! Ahhh!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: So... so many people... No, so many toys! Ahhh!
You're running frantically on the conveyor belt as Pepper's body gets heavier and heavier.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't panic. See the entrance of the conveyor belt up ahead? We're getting really close to victory.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: But I... I feel like... I can't run anymore...

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: The brilliant Pepper has a new idea! How about I distract the plastic dolls behind us, and then you can...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't even think about it!
It's true, the toyification is getting worse over time. Your movements are noticeably clumsier, and you can even feel the cotton lurching inside your body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're almost there! We can both get out, and there must be a way once we're out!
The pursuers behind you are getting closer and closer, and finally... just before they reach you, you and Pepper jump into the pitch-black entrance of the conveyor belt.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pepper? Are you okay?
No response?
It's a musty darkness inside, and you don't sense any sign of Pepper.
Given her character, whether she managed to escape or not, she wouldn't remain silent. Something's off.
You continue to take two steps forward, but bump your head into an unexpected plastic column.
Are you looking for that sheep?
The speaker sounds coherent, unlike the plastic people outside who have completely lost their self-awareness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you also a human who's trapped here and got turned into a toy?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Have you seen a blackface sheep?

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Yes, she didn't want to play with Bass, so she's out! I threw her out! Bass, strong!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Are you also ditching Bass to play with other friends?
Communication seems difficult. The cold and rough plastic toy pats the back of your cotton head in a half-threatening, half-curious fashion.
The speaker seems to be acting strange. When you can't tell someone's intention, there's only ever one right choice...

Without looking back, you run desperately into the depths of the darkness, your cotton body almost rolling on the conveyor belt. As you roll, you still catch a glimpse of the real face of the shadow behind you. A yellow screaming chicken swinging its flexible neck and chasing after you relentlessly.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Another person who despises Bass! You meanie!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Bass is smart and strong! Bass protects everyone! Makes everyone happy!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Why don't you want to be friends with Bass?

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: <color=#fb9259><size=50>Why!!!</size></color>
